name: Nothing X Advanced Equaliser (8-band)
notes: Nothing X app's 'Advanced Equaliser' for Nothing Ear / Ear (2) / Ear (3) / Headphone (1). The real app is more flexible than this spec can capture: each of its 8 bands has an independently adjustable centre frequency (within a fixed allowed range per band, per reverse-engineered profile data at github.com/charlieRub/nothing-x-eq-toolkit) plus a Q factor -- not just a fixed-frequency gain slider. The frequencies here are the midpoint of each band's disclosed allowed range: [20-100, 100-200, 200-400, 400-1000, 1000-3000, 3000-6000, 6000-12000, 12000-20000] Hz. Gain is stored as a continuous float with no publicly disclosed min/max; modeled here as continuous within an assumed +/-6 dB span.
